subject.title: feat(models): dynamic model catalogs via hosted refresh overlay

question: Should OpenClaw ship a default-on hosted model-catalog refresh that contacts `catalog.openclaw.ai` at Gateway startup and every six hours, with an opt-out configuration setting?
rationale: This is a new product and operator-policy surface rather than a repair to an established behavior; code correctness alone cannot choose the default network and update contract.

options.title: Approve the hosted default
options.body: Accept the default-on refresh after the workflow credential scope is narrowed and real fresh-install and upgrade proof is supplied.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep bundled catalogs as the default and require administrators to enable hosted refresh if the project does not want new outbound traffic by default.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until hosted infrastructure, ownership, privacy wording, and release support commitments are agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve the hosted default
recommendation.body: Accept the default-on refresh after the workflow credential scope is narrowed and real fresh-install and upgrade proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows this contributor authored the integrated proposal and is best positioned to clarify its intended product and operational contract.
